body: Orchestrator adversarial review of PR #265 head 5db32001 (dotfiles-T90b, mechanical sole-merger ruleset; Codex security seat): README documents two main rulesets as JSON payloads with the activation order and a scratch-PR verification table: the integrity ruleset (no bypass actors; strict seven required checks, review-thread resolution, deletion and non-fast-forward protection, zero approvals) that updates the existing 'main integration gate', and the merge-control ruleset (update restriction with update_allows_fetch_and_merge false plus one required approval) whose sole bypass actor is the orchestrator User in pull_request mode (numeric id verified via gh api user). The orchestrator's merge becomes the synchronous REST call `gh api --method PUT .../pulls/<pr>/merge -f merge_method=squash -f sha=<head>` for worker PRs and its own boundary PRs, because gh pr merge refuses BLOCKED without --admin and auto-merge completion ignores bypass (cli/cli#13388, github/docs#45265); before activation gh pr merge --squash still works. The gate's role check activates on an update rule or a required approval, requires the current user's id to be the sole User bypass actor in pull_request mode of every restricting ruleset (fail closed), requires the orchestrator's approval on a worker PR's head, and exempts only a non-empty .orchestration-only PR authored by the orchestrator. SKILL step 10 (approve, then REST merge after activation; boundary bullets qualified 'before activation') and the rule's integration-order sentence point at that procedure. Tests: 783 full, 76 focused on the gate; CI 13/13 on 5db32001; no Bot review in 15 min, no threads. Four PONG decisions recorded in the task file. No live activation (operator).
